description:
Create an Entity-Relationship (ER) diagram for a library management system in draw.io.

draw.io is open with a blank canvas and the shape palette visible on the left side.

CREATE THE ER DIAGRAM:

Design a library management database schema with these 4 entities and their key attributes:

1. BOOK entity: book_id (PK), title, isbn, and other relevant fields
2. AUTHOR entity: author_id (PK), name, and other relevant fields
3. MEMBER entity: member_id (PK), name, email, and other relevant fields
4. LOAN entity: loan_id (PK), book_id (FK), member_id (FK), loan_date, and other relevant fields

CONNECT THE ENTITIES:
- BOOK to AUTHOR (a book has one or more authors)
- BOOK to LOAN (books can be loaned)
- MEMBER to LOAN (members borrow books)

You can use shapes from the Entity Relation or General sections of the shape palette on the left sidebar.

SAVE THE FILE:
Use File > Save As (or Ctrl+Shift+S) to save the file as 'library_er_diagram.drawio' on the Desktop (/home/ga/Desktop).

CRITICAL REQUIREMENTS:
- All 4 entities must be present with text labels (Book, Author, Member, Loan)
- Each entity must have at least 2 visible attributes/fields
- At least 3 connections between entities
- File must be saved as 'library_er_diagram.drawio' on the Desktop
